mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP3A4 and CYP2C9), reducing disulfiram metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations and risk of toxicity.
action: Monitor for increased disulfiram adverse effects (psychotic reactions, peripheral neuropathy, hepatotoxicity); consider alternative H2-blocker (famotidine) or dose adjustment of disulfiram if cimetidine is necessary.
